title: Notification Channel settings missing on new phone
symptom: On a new Pixel 5 phone, the user cannot configure the glucose alerts notification channel (bgAlertChannel) as they could on their old Pixel 2 XL. The channel only shows a toggle to enable/disable, not the individual alert settings, preventing alarms from vibrating and breaking through Do Not Disturb mode.
cause: The thread does not definitively identify a root cause. It is suggested that Android 11 may not expose notification channel settings until a notification fires, and that xDrip may not be registering the channel properly. Later, a maintainer notes that notification channels cannot be transferred to a new phone and may behave differently across devices, but the exact cause is not established.
fix: The issue was resolved after updating to the 2026.07.12 release of xDrip, as reported by a maintainer. The maintainer also mentions that xDrip has made improvements to reduce dependence on notification channels and plans to add full control of alerts without needing them.
evidence_quote: After updating to the 2026.07.12 release, the problem has been resolved.
